q: ln(a + b) = ln a + ln b
why: Myth. There is no rule for the log of a sum.

q: By the rule of 70, how many years does it take to double at 3.5% growth?
Take logs of Y = A K^0.4 L^0.6.
o: ln Y = ln A + 0.4 ln K + 0.6 ln L
ln Y = ln A × 0.4 ln K × 0.6 ln L
why: Products become sums and powers become multipliers.
